newsitem.title: UK: Virgin Express confirms interest in Liberte.
newsitem.headline: Virgin Express confirms interest in Liberte.

text.p: British-owned European shorthaul airline Virgin Express has been in direct contact with a court-appointed liquidator in connection with troubled French airline Air Liberte, a Virgin group spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We put in a proposal which does not involve the acquisition of Air Liberte," Will Whitehorn, spokesman for entrepreneur Richard Branson's privately-owned Virgin Group, told Reuters.

The judicial administrator in the case said earlier he had received three firm offers before a Monday deadline, and an expression of interest from Virgin Express, but it had not been possible to confirm this with Virgin initially.

Whitehorn said Brussels-based Virgin Express "had been in direct contact", but he was not willing to give any more details of the nature of the company's proposal or whether it planned to follow up this move with any other form of offer.
British Airways submitted a 25 million franc bid on Monday in spite of reports Paris would resist a foreign bidder.
The two French groups are a consortium led by travel company Nouvelles Frontieres that includes Royal Air Maroc, and another grouping led by pilot Fernand Danan and representing staff of airline AOM.
